subject: S04 done (rework + e2e guard + checklist)
body:
S04 rework complete. On claude/naadi-shared at 752c01f (earlier steps 9f5aa65, 8a22e28, f34af7d).

Since the reopen, in short:
- All 13 review items and the first-deploy race fix (earlier integrations).
- e2e DB/Supabase guard (f34af7d, note 20261116T202605). Hosted DATABASE_URL / SUPABASE_URL are refused at config load unless E2E_ALLOW_HOSTED=1. Values are passed explicitly. Provider keys are blank unless E2E_LIVE_LLM=1. 17 node-env vitest cases.
- Checklist work (752c01f): agent_runtime health now carries a structured `agent` object (reason code, graph ids, failing checks, last cron ping). /admin/agent words it with new agent.diag.runtime_* / check_* keys and never shows the server's English detail. runtime_status no longer imports the host module, which built the whole Aegra app. Added an APP_ENV=prod e2e for /admin/agent: ping plus media block under the production CSP, zero console errors. src/agent added to noHardcodedCopy ROOTS.

CI: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43960853957 (752c01f). Every job reads "not started: recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased". This is GitHub billing on the account, so CI judged nothing. Local substitute: agent.spec over the full 18-project matrix, 144/144 (at f6aebcf, before the runtime-facts change).

REVIEW_CHECKLIST results (my surfaces: /admin/agent, agent API, llm.py, search.py):
Copy and UI
- [x] ui_copy only. agent.diag.* keys are in app_config.yaml and REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS, and defaults are regenerated. src/agent is in noHardcodedCopy (passes).
- [x] Structured server fields. agent_runtime now has reason codes. ping_result is {outcome, provider, model, latency_ms}. Errors map by status plus request id. NOTE: ComponentHealth.detail stays an English sentence for every other component in seg01's HealthPanel, which is outside S04.
- [x] One lime CTA (Run ping). Every status chip carries a word (OK/Degraded/Down, Unavailable, quota).
- [x] Phone 390/412: no truncation or overlap in /admin/agent; the screenshots were inspected. NOTE (not mine): in the 390 screenshots the shell's floating tab bar truncates its labels ("To...", "Le..."); seg07's 14c03e1 mentions a tab-bar fix.
- [x] No dead links or buttons. Run ping is disabled with the offline banner as the reason. Source links are real.
- [n/a] Keyboard shortcuts: S04 adds none.
Security, leaks, privacy
- [n/a/x] Answers before attempt: the agent platform serves no question content. The assistant-in-exam rule belongs to the assistant segment.
- [x] RLS and grants are in 0005/0007. The RLS coverage test and live_check list include llm_usage, search_cache, search_usage, agent_health. Single alembic chain (0001-0009 after rebase).
- [x] Production CSP: new APP_ENV=prod e2e, zero console errors, with images and the YouTube iframe loading under prod img-src/frame-src.
- [x] Scrubbing: llm.py loads PrivacyContext itself (fail closed); search scrubs before requests and before the cache key; probe tests. No request bodies logged.
- [x] Free only: `:free` OpenRouter and NVIDIA via the proxy. Every LLM call goes through llm.py.
Tests
- [x] API unit 507 passed (one deselect, test_workflows, not mine). ruff and mypy clean. db 223 passed on the local stack (seg07's search db tests need `python -m naadi_api.embeddings prefetch` first; perf test skipped without the seeded corpus). Live 3/3 within budget: about 6 model calls (NVIDIA first) and 1 Tavily credit. Web vitest passes (agent, test, health, noHardcodedCopy). typecheck and biome clean on my paths. gen:contracts and gen:requirements: no drift.
- [x] Local smoke set (webkit-ipad-portrait/landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440), --retries=0, 2x in a row: 36/36 and 36/36. Earlier attempts at load average 28-39 on 4 cores timed out in WebKit context creation. The runs that counted started once the load was under 10.
- [x] Waits: fonts are loaded before going offline; media polls image completion; the recorded stream is route-fulfilled.
- [x] Screenshots: 8 states x 18 projects in test-results/screens/04. No board covers the admin diagnostics page; it follows System tokens.

Blocking shared, not mine (posted 20261116T212918, 20261116T213103): biome format errors in apps/web/src/search/search.test.tsx (seg07) and packages/shared/fixtures/ink/*.json (ink). My integrate ran biome on my own paths.
Hygiene confession: before the checklist I stopped servers with pkill -f 'naadi_api.agent.host:app', which can have killed other agents' e2e servers. I now match only my worktree path.
